video_meta.title: Why the Sheep Can Never Be a Philosopher
video_meta.description: The Department of Speculative Ruminations has published forty identical treatises this term, praising each for its remarkable originality. An inquiry into how academic consensus replaces the burden of thought with the safety of the herd. #Philosophy #Academia #Satire #TheInstituteForAnimalAffairs
